paragraphs.text: At the pantry door, Lena stopped breathing long enough to hear the latch move on the other side. Someone was lifting it slowly, trying to keep the metal tongue from clicking. She slid the flour bin against the door and climbed onto the shelf beneath the window.

The actor leaves a long pause after asking for the rent. During it, the tenant counts out coins that are visibly short of the amount, then puts her wedding ring beside them. The pause gives the audience time to see the offer before the landlord refuses it.

The tailor unpicked the underarm seam and inserted a temporary strip of cloth, then asked her to repeat the movement. That second attempt determined the width of the gusset needed for the production's overhead lifting scene.

The documentary's long pause has a measurable purpose in the scene. The witness counts the interval between the warning siren and the first impact by tapping once a second, and the editor leaves the full count on screen. Cutting away would conceal the timing on which the witness's account depends.

My uncle paused at the border officer's question because the place where he was born had changed names twice. He showed the name printed on his birth certificate, then pointed to the current name on the officer's map. The delay came from reconciling those records, and the officer entered both names before returning the passport.
